Treat the next denominator-expansion task as rulegen/SRS resource work, not LLM prompt work.
Keep the 1,984 learner-target universe and 570 replacement-family universe labeled separately in product docs.

expansion_levers.effect: Can increase the SRS target universe beyond the current 1,984 unique target lemmas.
expansion_levers.risk: Only helps semantic veto if rulegen can produce visible source-target rules for the added targets.

expansion_levers.effect: Can increase the 570 replacement-family denominator from the existing 1,984 targets.
expansion_levers.risk: Can also add weak or awkward source-target mappings that need review before LLM spend.

expansion_levers.effect: Can admit some of the 115 currently excluded families.
expansion_levers.risk: Would intentionally accept identical/no-visible or weak mappings that were excluded for product reasons.

expansion_levers.effect: Can improve veto quality for already covered families with harmful-replacement classes.
expansion_levers.risk: Does not expand the denominator by itself.

limitations: This audit reads existing no-spend artifacts; it does not rerun full rulegen.
The 570 denominator is current-resource truth, not a claim about all en-es vocabulary.
The 115 exclusions were manually reviewed for active-only generation value, not for every possible future product policy.
Coverage means active-only evidence coverage, not broad semantic-veto accuracy.

methodology.coverage_definition: A family is covered when the combined active-only semantic evidence pack has anchor_cue evidence for the normalized English trigger and Spanish target.
methodology.denominator_definition: The semantic-veto source-target denominator is the set of current rulegen-produced English source / Spanish target replacement families for the installed en-es SRS target universe.
methodology.exclusion_definition: The remaining uncovered families are active-only exclusions from the source-target review manifest, not pending LLM-generation rows.
methodology.not_the_denominator: The 1,984 SRS-admissible Spanish target lemmas are the learner target universe, not the browser replacement-family denominator.
